description.value: Bar Tartare is a natural wine bar in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood that rotates guest chefs through its kitchen, offering a dining experience that shifts with each chef's creative vision. The intimate venue at 54 Alexander Street pairs its evolving food program with a curated list of natural wines. Touring cyclists exploring Gastown will find it a distinctive option for an evening meal in one of Vancouver's most storied districts.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (12 spaces) at 39m; stands (2 spaces) at 56m; stands (4 spaces) at 64m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating French-style natural wine bar at 54 Alexander Street, Vancouver, consistent with OSM tags. The OSM name 'Bar Tartar' differs from the website's consistent usage of 'Bar Tartare' — flagged as a concern. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned in either OSM tags or website content, so all amenity fields are null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Bar Tartar' but the business's own website consistently uses 'Bar Tartare' — OSM tag may contain a spelling error.
